The Multi-counter module adds no external data source, API, network service or third-party library of its own.

It uses the Android/Kotlin/Jetpack Compose facilities and MethodMesh runtime components already supplied by the host application. Any attribution or licence obligations for those host dependencies remain governed by the MethodMesh application-level notices.

No capability-specific attribution is displayed in the native result surface.
